messages:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up 1: short thread to lock owners/timelines for alert-tuning tasks (night noise, thresholds, cross-AZ dupes, paging policy). Please ack and add any constraints.

Felix: I can take the night-noise work (telemetry exporter + retry churn). Plan: run 21d hourly heatmap, drop two noisy error subclasses, add backoff in exporter, and add a nighttime suppression window. Target: 2026-04-05.

June: I'll own prediction-service thresholds and the rollback play. Steps: collect 14d memory/oom events, propose conservative threshold + aggressive threshold, smoke in staging for 72h. Target: 2026-03-30.

Ravi: I'll prototype cross-AZ dedupe and the simple probabilistic backoff idea. Prototype: signature = sha1(service+error_class+topframe), window=10m, probabilistic suppression after 3 repeats. Will include visibility (count suppressed, last_seen). Target: 2026-04-03.

Maya: Ops-bot, create ticket INFR-4742 and calendar. Acceptance metrics: nightly_pager_count (baseline), unique_alert_signatures, suppressed_page_count, median_time_to_ack.

ops-bot: Ticket INFR-4742 created and assigned to <@Felix>, <@June>, <@Ravi>. Due dates: Felix 2026-04-05, June 2026-03-30, Ravi 2026-04-03. Recurring "Alert Quality Review" added biweekly starting 2026-03-31.

Felix: example PromQL for heatmap:
```
count_over_time(alerts_fired_total{alertname=~"TelemetryExporter.*"}[1h])[21d:]
```
Uploading CSV to INFR-4742.

Ravi: prototype config (WIP):
```
- name: cross-az-proto
  signature: sha1(service,error.class,stack_hash:6)
  window: 10m
  suppression: \"probabilistic_after=3,backoff=exp\"
```
I'll include tests to ensure we don't hide new error classes.

June: will post threshold candidates + staging metrics by EOD Thursday. Will add revert runbook with Ansible steps.

Maya: Nice. Two small asks: 1) include a clear verification query we can run each morning, 2) make sure Support has a short note about expected changes.

Felix: verification query will be nightly_pagers_by_service. Ill add the dashboard panel.

Ravi: adding a field suppressed_reason and a webhook to #eng-oncall when suppression rate > 40% for any alert.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll ping Product/Support after ticket owners confirm. See you at the first Alert Quality Review. :thumbsup:
